parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity records for CHEMBL3183703 and its salt forms against target CHEMBL1741208. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL3183703 to retrieve all related molregnos. Retrieve activity provenance using the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Filter by target CHEMBL1741208 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
